Certainly! Here’s an MCQ on the cause of hypoparathyroidism:

---

**Which of the following is the most common cause of hypoparathyroidism?**

A) Parathyroid adenoma  
B) Autoimmune destruction of the parathyroid glands  
C) Surgical removal or damage to the parathyroid glands  
D) Vitamin D deficiency  

**Answer:**  
C) Surgical removal or damage to the parathyroid glands
